Container.Name: ProxyServer
Container.Overview:
High-performance Reverse Proxy Gateway & Automated Cloudflare Dynamic DNS (DDNS) Manager.
Features: - Zero-downtime dynamic reverse proxy routing without restarting - Replaces standalone containers like oznu/docker-cloudflare-ddns - Automated Let's Encrypt ACME SSL certificates & HTTPS redirection - Modern dark-mode React UI with live traffic telemetry & health checks - Administrator authentication, rate limiting, and gateway access protection

Config.Name: Web Management UI Port
Config.Description: Port for Web Management UI and Admin REST API

Config.Name: HTTP Reverse Proxy Port
Config.Description: HTTP Reverse Proxy port & Let's Encrypt ACME challenges (can be mapped to Host 80 if available)

Config.Name: HTTPS Reverse Proxy Port
Config.Description: HTTPS Reverse Proxy port with TLS (can be mapped to Host 443 if available)

Config.Name: AppData Storage Path
Config.Description: Host directory for persistent config (config.json) and TLS certificates

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (Unraid 'nobody' is 99)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (Unraid 'users' is 100)
